title: Trapp's Complete Commentary on the Old and New Testaments
author: John Trapp
description: Pithy verse-level exposition from John Trapp's five-volume commentary on the Old and New Testaments; the bundled SermonIndex corpus covers 65 books and 1,186 chapters, with three verified upstream gaps.
